import sys,importlib.util,json,urllib.request,urllib.parse,urllib.error,time
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m","/root/direct-sync/maersk_track_sync.py")
sys.argv=["x"]; m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
env=m.load_env(); tok=m.maersk_token(env)
def ev(params):
    q=urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    r=urllib.request.Request(m.EVENTS_URL+"?"+q,headers={"Consumer-Key":env["MAERSK_CONSUMER_KEY"],
      "Authorization":"Bearer "+tok,"Accept":"application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=60) as x:
            js=json.loads(x.read().decode() or "{}")
            return js.get("events",[]) if isinstance(js,dict) else js
    except Exception: return []
def descr(evs):
    out=[]
    for e in evs:
        c=e.get("equipmentEventTypeCode") or e.get("transportEventTypeCode") or e.get("shipmentEventTypeCode") or "?"
        mode=(e.get("transportCall") or {}).get("modeOfTransport") or ""
        ves=((e.get("transportCall") or {}).get("vessel") or {}).get("vesselName") or ""
        out.append("%s/%s%s%s"%(str(e.get("eventDateTime"))[:10],c,("/"+mode if mode else ""),("/"+ves if ves else "")))
    return out
for num in ("264900732","266155609"):
    b=ev({"carrierBookingReference":num}); time.sleep(1.2)
    d=ev({"transportDocumentReference":num}); time.sleep(1.2)
    ids=lambda L:{x.get("eventID") for x in L}
    print("BL %s: по букінгу %d, по коносаменту %d, разом унікальних %d"%(num,len(b),len(d),len(ids(b)|ids(d))))
    print("   букінг     :",", ".join(descr(b))[:180])
    print("   коносамент :",", ".join(descr(d))[:180])
print("контейнер зі скріншота BSIU8155990:",len(ev({"equipmentReference":"BSIU8155990"})),"подій")
EOF
